counties.notes: Jackson County MO (Kansas City metro; county seat Kansas City; FIPS 29095; pop. 715,000, largest county in MO) provides parcel data via gis.mijackson.org. The RealEstate/RealEstateParcels/FeatureServer/0 layer exposes 20 fields: PIN (parcel ID), LIBERPAGE, O_CITY, OWNER, OWNER2, O_STATE, O_ADDRESS, O_ZIP, P_CITY, P_FULLADD, P_STATE, P_ZIP, P_STATUS, P_ACREAGE, P_ASSMBOR1-4, P_HPERCENT. Owner search via UPPER(OWNER) LIKE works well. Verified 2026-06-20: SMITH returns Kansas City-area addresses. Jackson County MO includes Kansas City proper and inner suburbs (Independence, Lee's Summit, Blue Springs). Do not confuse with Jackson County in other states. The GIS portal is at gis.mijackson.org.

counties.notes: St. Louis County MO (St. Louis metro west/south, county seat Clayton, NOT the independent City of St. Louis) provides AGS_Parcels/MapServer/0 with 30+ fields: LOCATOR (parcel ID), PARENT_LOC, TAXYR, OWNER_NAME, PROP_ADRNUM, PROP_ADD, PROP_ZIP, OWN_ADD, OWN_CITY, OWN_STATE, OWN_ZIP, SCHSUB (school subdivision), MUNYCODE (municipality code), TAXCODE, ASSTIMPVAL, TOTASSMT, APPLANDVAL, APPIMPVAL, TOTAPVAL, PROPCLASS, LUC, LANDUSE2, LUCODE, TENURE, BLDGNAME, TWPNAME. Query confirmed live: UPPER(OWNER_NAME) LIKE '%SMITH%' returns real results (e.g., 'SMITH KIMBERLY & ANTHONY T/E' at '11041 LILAC AVE'). St. Louis County MO (FIPS 29189) is a separate entity from the City of St. Louis (FIPS 29510, an independent city not part of any county). The GeoData portal at data-stlcogis.opendata.arcgis.com provides open data downloads and GeoServices API links. The maps.stlouisco.com server is the live REST host.

counties.notes: City of St. Louis, Missouri (FIPS 29510) is an independent city that belongs to no county, and it is NOT St. Louis County (29189, a separate record in this file on a different server). The Assessor's public parcels layer is ASSESSOR/Assessor_Public_Parcels/MapServer layer 11 (Parcels) on ArcGIS Server 11.2, listed on the city's data page. SERVER-SIDE ONLY: the server sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin only to its own origin (www.stlouis-mo.gov); for any other Origin a GET and its preflight return only Vary: Origin and Access-Control-Allow-Private-Network: true, so a browser on another site cannot read it and corsEnabled is false. Query it from a server, the metered API or the MCP, not from page script. The owner is OwnerName (max 40 characters, so long names are truncated at the source) with OwnerName2; the mailing address is OwnerAddr plus OwnerCity (max 13 characters, can read ST LOUIS MO) with OwnerState, OwnerZIP and OwnerCountry; the parcel id is ParcelId (11 digits, LowerParcelId also exists). SITEADDR carries runs of internal spaces (2233   PARK AV) and trailing padding, so a LIKE on a full street string misses; search on the house number plus a street word, or collapse whitespace on the client. Search with UPPER(OwnerName) LIKE 'SMITH%'; broad searches return exceededTransferLimit true at the 2000-row page. The layer has 194 fields and this record lists a subset. Layer 11 includes condominium master parcels, and the sub-accounts are layer 10 (not examined). No license or terms text is published on the data page. Verified live 2026-10-03: owner SMITH returned rows (first SMITH, DAVID E & SANDRA L TRS, parcel 22669130000, 2233 PARK AVE).
